summary: Teck Resources filed a Form 6-K furnishing two October 28, 2026 press releases, principally its unaudited third-quarter 2026 results. No transaction terms are set; the filing reports Q3 adjusted EBITDA of $2.3 billion (up 97% year-over-year), profit before taxes of $2.3 billion, adjusted EPS of $1.88, $1.6 billion operating cash flow, and $10.9 billion liquidity including $6.7 billion cash. It references progress toward a planned merger with Anglo American without new structural or regulatory detail. Risk-arb angle centers on merger completion timing and approvals rather than this earnings release.
